content:
lee: Heads-up: small wave of customers reported that v2 calls silently landed on v1 during last night's quota-burst. Support tickets + a couple of dataplane alerts.
harper: Any quick logs to illustrate pattern?
lee: Snippet from edge collector (sanitized):
```
[2025-04-18T03:10:12Z] req=7a2 route=team/atlas intended=v2 status=THROTTLED mechanism=quota-burst-protector selected=team/atlas:v1 reason=route_affinity_override
```
lee: Important part: mechanism labeled `quota-burst-protector` and router chose v1 via an affinity override.
mona: We intentionally have an affinity override to avoid thrashing, but it should not silently ignore configured fallbacks. Looks like the override path has higher precedence than fallback.
devon: UX issue: tenants see quality drop with zero console hints. We should expose a tiny telemetry counter + optional ephemeral notice in the route timeline.
harper: Telemetry proposal: register metric `fallback_events.v2_to_v1` with tags {route,tenant,reason=quota_burst|affinity|header_norm|sticky}. Emit a counter on every selection and send a sampled event with decision_stack for 0.25% of events. Keep tag cardinality small.
mona: Also add a boolean `fallback_applied` in structured logs so we can backfill. And include `selected_variant` for billing reconciliation.
devon: Console change: in the route traffic row show a subtle icon when fallbacks > 0 in last 1h. Tooltip: "Some requests served by fallback variant v1 (click to view examples)". In incident view show a short banner: "Detected fallback routing due to quota-burst protections" + CTA.
lee: Root cause: twofold - (A) precedence order in router code, (B) the quota-burst-protector intentionally prefers affinity to reduce oscillation. We need to reconcile policy: for quota-triggered events, prefer explicit fallback first; affinity override can be applied only when no fallback configured.
harper: Implementation plan: 1) small router precedence patch: when mechanism==quota-burst-protector and fallback_variant is present, honor fallback (owner: mona, ETA: today). 2) metrics registration + sampling plan (owner: harper, ETA: tomorrow). 3) console micro-UI + banner copy (owner: devon, ETA: tomorrow AM). 4) ops saved query for support to surface recent tickets (owner: ops, ETA: today).
mona: I'll land the precedence patch behind a feature flag `router.fallback_respect_affinity` and add unit tests that reproduce both cases.
devon: For canary, run a shadow `quota-burst` experiment where we evaluate both old and new precedence without changing real routing for 1% of traffic, then compare `fallback_events.v2_to_v1` counts.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: mona/router-fallback-affinity-fix -> canary prod-1 at 2025-04-19T01:20:00Z. Shadow cohort: prod-canary at 2025-04-19T01:25:00Z.
harper: Also ensure metric backfill window covers the last 6h so CS can correlate tickets. We'll add a LogQL saved query for `fallback_applied=true`.
lee: Communication: notify CS to proactively reach out to tenants who reported quality drops and include a short explanation + remediation steps: increase reserved capacity, pin route to v2, or accept fallback.
mona: Note: we also need to audit gateways for header rewriting that can make the router unable to detect intended_variant. If found, emit a header_norm fallback reason.
devon: UX copy draft for banner: "Some requests were routed to a fallback variant due to quota burst protections. Recommended: increase reserved capacity or contact support to request dedicated capacity." Keep it short.
harper: After canary, run a replay test against recorded traffic and compare routing outcomes. If results align, roll the flag to 100% and enable metric for all tenants.
lee: Thanks — ping here if anyone sees unexpected spikes during canary.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: mona/router-fallback-affinity-fix -> canary in prod-1 at 2025-04-19T01:20:00Z.
